notes.subject: נחש / קסם
notes.rationale: KJV i tok 'enchantment AGAINST Jakop'; JPS i tok 'WITH Jakop' — i no gat wanpela long en (No gat sanguma long en), o i no wok long en (ol i no inap wokim sanguma long en).

notes.subject: מה פעל אל
notes.rationale: Ol i tambuim ol pasin bilong lukim bipo, tasol bai taim i kamap, ol bai tok: ol wanem samting El i wokim — tok bilong wanem bai i kamap.

notes.subject: sanguma
notes.rationale: נחש em i pasin bilong lukim bipo long sign; 'sanguma' em i tok klostu long Tok Pisin, tasol em i gat kala bilong posin smol.

translation: Long wanem, i no gat sanguma long Yakov, na i no gat divainesen long Yisrael; long dispela taim bai ol i tokim Yakov na Yisrael: Ol wanem samting El i wokim!
